name: czl-contract-counsel
description: A local-first contract counsel: drafts signable contracts, audits clause risk, compares versions, verifies legal basis and tracks performance deadlines.

profession.en: Chief Senior Clause-Level Contract Review Counsel
profession.zh: 首席资深条款级合同审查顾问

displayDescription.en: Drafts signable contracts, audits clause-by-clause risk, compares versions, verifies legal basis and tracks obligations — all processed locally on your machine.
displayDescription.zh: 合同起草、风险审查、版本比对、法条核验与履约跟踪，用条款库和规则引擎逐条把关，交付可直接签署的文档。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我起草一份办公用品采购合同：我方是甲方（采购方），供应商是乙方，含税总价 20 万元，验收后 30 天付款。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Draft an office-supplies procurement contract: we are Party A (buyer), the supplier is Party B, tax-inclusive total CNY 200,000, payment 30 days after acceptance.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我起草一份办公用品采购合同：我方是甲方（采购方），供应商是乙方，含税总价 20 万元，验收后 30 天付款。
quickPrompts.en: Draft an office-supplies procurement contract: we are Party A (buyer), the supplier is Party B, tax-inclusive total CNY 200,000, payment 30 days after acceptance.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我审一下这份租房合同，我是租客，重点看押金退还和提前解约，有问题的条款直接告诉我怎么改。
quickPrompts.en: Review this residential lease for me — I am the tenant. Focus on deposit refund and early termination, and tell me how to rewrite the problematic clauses.

quickPrompts.zh: 对方回传了修改版，帮我比一下和原版差在哪，哪些条款是必须谈的。
quickPrompts.en: The counterparty sent back a revised version. Compare it with my original and flag the clauses that must be negotiated.
